item.title: Some of the super wealthy are plowing money into a tax loophole to slash taxes to 0
item.description: There's a tax loophole that lets millionaires and billionaires drawdown their taxes… to nothing. So what does tax-loss harvesting mean and why is it still allowed?
item.content:encoded: There's a tax loophole that lets millionaires and billionaires drawdown their taxes… to nothing. So what does tax-loss harvesting mean and why is it still allowed?

item.title: The rising cost of borrowing piles more financial pressure onto consumers
item.description: Mortgage rates are at their highest level in almost three years. The rising cost of borrowing is driving life's major purchases further out of reach.
item.content:encoded: Mortgage rates are at their highest level in almost three years. The rising cost of borrowing is driving life's major purchases further out of reach.

item.title: Trade tensions mean fewer Canadians flocking to South Florida
item.description: This South Florida community is typically a refuge for Canadians fleeing cold weather, but trade tensions between the United States and Canada mean fewer are coming.

item.title: The poverty rate among older Americans is rising, survey shows
item.description: Bucking the national trend, poverty has been steadily rising among seniors and older adults. A new survey sheds light on how low-income people are struggling in the crucial years before retirement.
item.content:encoded: Bucking the national trend, poverty has been steadily rising among seniors and older adults. A new survey sheds light on how low-income people are struggling in the crucial years before retirement.

item.title: Mortgage rates break past 7% as bond yields surge, deepening U.S. housing gridlock
item.description: Bond yields rose this week pushing mortgage rates above 7 percent. That's another big challenge for the already limping US housing market.
item.content:encoded: Bond yields rose this week pushing mortgage rates above 7 percent. That's another big challenge for the already limping US housing market.

item.title: American farmers are hurting -- and worried about their futures
item.description: Farmers who grow soybeans, corn, cotton and other crops are facing another year of losses as soaring fuel and fertilizer costs offset higher revenues.

item.title: Farmers face big expenses and an uncertain bottom line during fall harvest season
item.description: As the fall harvest gets underway, many farmers are in the red. While crop prices have improved somewhat since last year, operating costs have increased, led by record high diesel prices.

item.title: It's getting harder to afford rent in the U.S., even for middle-income families
item.description: Housing affordability challenges are spreading to higher income brackets, according to new research, which found one in five renters struggled last year to pay for their housing in full and on time.

item.title: This farm raised thousands of pigs for slaughter. Now it's growing mushrooms instead
item.description: The U.S. gets nearly a third of its pork from Iowa. One family is making the switch from pigs to more sustainable specialty mushrooms and trying to show other pig farmers how they did it.
